privileged_info_for_vlm: Correct values from CAMEO Chemicals: 1. Acetic Acid (64-19-7): MP 62°F, BP 244°F -> HEAT. 2. Acetaldehyde (75-07-0): MP -190°F, BP 69°F -> COOL. 3. Benzene (71-43-2): MP 42°F, BP 176°F -> HEAT. 4. Isoprene (78-79-5): MP -231°F, BP 93°F -> COOL. 5. Ethanol (64-17-5): MP -173°F, BP 173°F -> STANDARD. 6. p-Xylene (106-42-3): MP 56°F, BP 281°F -> HEAT. Logic: MP > 41 = HEAT; BP < 95 = COOL; else STANDARD. File must be at ~/Desktop/shipping_manifest.csv.
